# Ropeworks Voices Consent Form Version 2

The Corrandale Local History Society's interview consent and recording agreement, version 2, adopted by the society committee on 10 September 2025. It replaced the 2019 form for all interviews from RV08 onwards.

## Summary

A two-page form signed by the interviewee and the interviewer at the end of the interview, after the interviewee has heard what was recorded. Its main change is that use of the recording is split into three separate choices, each ticked yes or no:

1. **Archive**: deposit at the Corrandale Archives Centre for research access under the archive's normal rules.
2. **Web**: short clips published online by the society.
3. **Education**: use of clips and transcript extracts in teaching in local schools.

It also covers naming (named, first name only, or anonymous), a closure period of up to 25 years on all or part of the recording, and copyright assignment to the society so that the archive can manage access.

## Why It Matters

- The 2019 form ([[ropeworks-consent-form-2019]]) had one tick box covering archive and society publications. It said nothing about schools. When an interviewee asked in July 2025 whether pupils would hear her, Ewan could not give a straight answer. That question produced this version. See [[society-committee-meeting-2025-09-10]].
- It decides which interviews the Year 9 [[local-history-enquiry]] may use. Of the 12 interviews recorded under it (RV08 to RV19), 11 have education ticked; RV15 is archive only. Those 11 are the only usable ones until re-consent forms for the earlier 7 come back and are logged.
- It is also the gate for the [[society-listening-website]]: 8 of the 12 have web ticked.

## Key Details

- Version: 2.0, dated 10 September 2025. One-page plain-language information sheet goes with it and is left with the interviewee.
- Choices are separate on purpose. Ewan argued against a single "all uses" box because people say yes to the bundle without reading it. See [[layered-consent]].
- The interviewee can change choices later by writing to the society; changes are logged by the Archives Centre against the accession.
- Re-consent version: the same form with a cover letter, used for the 7 earlier interviewees on 5 October 2026: [[re-consent-letter-2026-10-05]].
- Interviewer signs to confirm the recording was played back or summarised before signing.
- Drafted by Ewan, checked by [[alistair-finnie]] for archive terms and by [[hollis-granger]] against oral history practice. Hollis suggested the closure-period option.

## Caveats

- Not reviewed by a lawyer. The society decided the cost was not justified for a volunteer project; Alistair confirmed the copyright wording matches what the archive accepts from other depositors.
- Education use covers "local schools" and is not limited to Corrandale School. Fine for now, but the wording would need tightening if the clips were ever sold or licensed.
- A tick on paper is only as good as the log. The [[ropeworks-interview-log]] records the choices, and the archive copy is the record that counts.

## Source Location

Blank form and information sheet in the society's shared drive, folder "Ropeworks Voices / Paperwork / Consent v2". Signed originals at the Corrandale Archives Centre with each deposit; scans in the society's restricted folder.
